sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rishikesh Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record 2.

This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.215 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Kagaraul, District Agra with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is father-in-law of deceased.

Though, the marriage of deceased with son of applicant-accused has taken place 10.05.2023 but the allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased, levelled against applicant-accused, are wholly false.

It was submitted that only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been Bhoori Singh Pradhan vs State Of U.P. on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10579048/
1 levelled against all the accused persons, including applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was further submitted that applicant was residing at Agra, whereas, the deceased along with her husband was residing at village Dauretha.
It was stated that deceased has committed suicide due to depression.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.
The criminal history of five cases shown against applicant-accused, has duly been explained in affidavit.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 06.02.2024 and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death other than under normal circumstances within a period of seven years of her marriage.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicantBhoori Singh Pradhan involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.

iii. 
The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

8. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 12.4.2024 Neeraj/Anand  Bhoori Singh Pradhan vs State Of U.P. on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10579048/
